PROJECT_GENESIS_SUBTITLE: Synthetic data generator for IoT systems in Smart University environments
PROJECT_GENESIS_DESCRIPTION: Genesis 2.0 is a web tool for simulating Smart University environments through synthetic IoT sensor data generation. It allows creating complex temporal patterns and exporting realistic datasets for integration into external analytics applications.
PROJECT_GENESIS_FEATURE_1: Quality synthetic data generation based on configurable temporal patterns
PROJECT_GENESIS_FEATURE_2: Dataset export in JSON and CSV formats for external analysis
PROJECT_GENESIS_FEATURE_3: Portable application currently running on web browsers and desktop environments on Windows via Electron
PROJECT_GENESIS_ARCHITECTURE_1: Modular design based on Angular Standalone Components
PROJECT_GENESIS_ARCHITECTURE_2: High-frequency reactive stream management using RxJS
PROJECT_GENESIS_ARCHITECTURE_3: Detailed technical documentation and step-by-step user manual
PROJECT_GENESIS_ARCHITECTURE_4: Test data featuring realistic use cases modeled for Smart Campus scenarios (occupancy, CO2, power consumption)
PROJECT_VISIONARY_SUBTITLE: 3D educational platform and AI for human eye anatomy
PROJECT_VISIONARY_DESCRIPTION: Visionary is an interactive educational platform combining a 3D human eye model with an AI chatbot to study anatomy, physiology, and pathologies. It includes adaptive quizzes and real-time analytics for teachers to track student progress.
PROJECT_VISIONARY_FEATURE_1: 3D human eye model rendering and interaction powered by Three.js
PROJECT_VISIONARY_FEATURE_2: Virtual assistant (AI Chatbot) trained in ocular anatomy and pathology
PROJECT_VISIONARY_FEATURE_3: Adaptive quizzes with immediate feedback for students
PROJECT_VISIONARY_FEATURE_4: Teacher dashboard to monitor student progress
PROJECT_VISIONARY_ARCHITECTURE_1: Three.js integration within Angular component lifecycle
PROJECT_VISIONARY_ARCHITECTURE_2: Chart and metric visualization using Chart.js
PROJECT_VISIONARY_ARCHITECTURE_3: Graphics engine management supporting both Three.js and WebGPU for high-efficiency rendering and visual quality
PROJECT_FERPLAY_SUBTITLE: C2C mobile marketplace for buying and selling video games
PROJECT_FERPLAY_DESCRIPTION: Ferplay is a mobile app designed to connect gamers through buying and selling video games. An intuitive, agile platform that lets users list titles, discover new gaming experiences, and give a second life to their collection.
PROJECT_FERPLAY_FEATURE_1: Fast listing creation with image upload and geolocation
PROJECT_FERPLAY_FEATURE_2: User rating and review system to build trust and transparency
PROJECT_FERPLAY_FEATURE_3: Filtering by platform, item condition, price, and geographic distance
PROJECT_FERPLAY_FEATURE_5: Shopping cart and purchase history system for a complete user experience
PROJECT_FERPLAY_ARCHITECTURE_1: Cross-platform hybrid development using Ionic Framework + Angular
PROJECT_FERPLAY_ARCHITECTURE_2: Backend built with PHP and Symfony, featuring a RESTful architecture and JWT-based security
PROJECT_FERPLAY_ARCHITECTURE_3: Usage of native Capacitor plugins for camera and geolocation access
